extra.summary: Discover the UOB PRVI Miles Card, your ultimate travel companion! Earn up to 8 miles for agoda & Expedia bookings via UOB PRVI Miles website! Or earn 3 miles per S$1 spent on regional spend in Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand, Vietnam, 2.4 miles on other overseas spend and 1.4 miles for local spending. With no annual fee for the first year, maximize your rewards and make every trip unforgettable. Enjoy exclusive travel perks like complimentary travel insurance and lounge visits!

our_takes.our-take: The UOB PRVI Miles Mastercard excels for frequent travellers wanting fuss-free miles, offering 3 miles per S$1 on regional spend (Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam) and 2.4 miles elsewhere overseas, including online. Locally, you’ll earn 1.4 miles per S$1, even on bus and train rides. The card waives the first year fee and includes four complimentary lounge visits. A potential boost of up to 8 miles per S$1 via Agoda/Expedia and KrisFlyer miles for new KrisFlyer UOB account holders cater to avid spenders, especially on holidays.
our_takes.good-for:
Frequent travellers who want to maximise miles on overseas spending, especially across Southeast Asia, including online shopping.
Cardholders who enjoy earning accelerated miles on travel bookings made through Agoda and Expedia via UOB PRVI Miles website.
Individuals with substantial monthly spending who want fuss-free miles accrual to redeem for flights, without minimum spends or earning caps.
our_takes.things-to-note:
A high 27.8% interest rate applies on unpaid balances, so pay your balance in full monthly.
Foreign transaction fees of 3.25% can add up; consider using cards with lower fees abroad.
Late payment fees of S$100 apply, so set up payment reminders to avoid extra charges.
